solve.min_knowledge: VP term 5 years; ex-officio RS Chairman; acts as President until a successor (<= 6 months).

units.label: a
units.text: Regarding the office of Vice-President: The Vice-President office is modelled on the lines of the American Vice-President
units.subject_rule: Polity: a function within one office (RS chair) moved to the whole office (VP)

units.label: b
units.text: Regarding the office of Vice-President: The Vice-President is elected by an electoral college of members of both Houses of Parliament
units.subject_rule: Polity: a function within one office (RS chair) moved to the whole office (VP)

units.label: c
units.text: Regarding the office of Vice-President: All doubts and disputes about the VP election are decided by the Supreme Court
units.subject_rule: Polity: a function within one office (RS chair) moved to the whole office (VP)

units.label: d
units.text: Regarding the office of Vice-President: If the VP office falls vacant, the Deputy Chairman of the Rajya Sabha acts as Vice-President until a new VP is elected
units.true_fact: The Constitution is silent on an acting VP; the Deputy Chairman only performs the Chairman's duties in the RS.
units.subject_rule: Polity: a function within one office (RS chair) moved to the whole office (VP)

solve.steps: a-c are standard true features; there is no acting VP provision, so d is the false one.
solve.min_knowledge: No constitutional provision for an acting VP.
